description: This file defines the EmailConfigurationDao class, which provides data access methods for EmailConfiguration entities, such as retrieving and saving email configuration data in the database within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for EmailConfiguration entity, providing methods to retrieve and save email configuration data.

methods.name: getEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the email configuration from the database. Returns an EmailConfiguration object if found, otherwise null.

methods.name: saveEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the provided EmailConfiguration object to the database and returns it.
